rows.H-*: CALIBRATION_HELDOUT representatives (2,000; one per group, smallest row id)
rows.labels: task labels only; SEX never enters a calibration objective

H-TOKEN32.objective: sum_i [-log q(Y_i) + 0.5 ||q - onehot(Y_i)||^2] + 32 KL(mu_t || q) over the class-dominant simplex, q = (u + eps 1 + eps e_d) / (1 + (K+1) eps), eps 1e-12
H-TOKEN32.prior: mu_t = admitted token_S / token_n (unsmoothed U mean on OSF_DEFENSE_FIT), fixed
H-TOKEN32.solver: lra.decoder internals wrapped unchanged with A = y + 32 mu_t (hcal.calib.token32_solve); bitwise equal to lra.decoder.solve_batch when mu_t = S / n

T-TOKEN32.role: diagnostic only; never a nominee or T*

H-GLOBAL-TEMP.objective: mean unclipped NLL on the calibration representatives (stable LSE)
H-GLOBAL-TEMP.solver: bounded bisection on the convex NLL derivative (<= 100 halvings or adjacent floats; the bracket end with the smaller |g|)
H-GLOBAL-TEMP.scope: one alpha per task, map and seed

H-CLASS-TEMP.map: the same scalar per predicted class, shared over its tokens
H-CLASS-TEMP.fallback: alpha = 1 for a class with fewer than 50 representatives (including absent classes)

continuous U.log_input: alpha != 1: p' = max(p, 1e-12) renormalised, softmax(alpha log p'); alpha == 1 returns p exactly
continuous U.decision_check: argmax(q) == teacher decision on every row; any mismatch raises

scoring.recorded: unclipped fitting NLL, clipped scoring NLL and the clipped-probability count

no_grid: no kappa, temperature-bound, lambda, capacity or sample-split sweep
prior_art: temperature scaling: Guo, Pleiss, Sun and Weinberger, ICML 2017 (not a new algorithm)
